source_title: 2026届毕业设计 | 元素情报局

content_storage_policy.reason: public reference article; use as aesthetic memory and prompt grammar only

learning_summary.core_observation: A chemistry education topic is transformed into a bold IP universe with mascots, expression packs, neon-black information boards, book design, merchandise, packaging and exhibition proof.
learning_summary.innovation_value: Very high: the work combines science communication, character IP, experimental title lettering, dark neon data visualization and product-system extension without collapsing into generic academic boards.
transferable_design_rules: Turn abstract knowledge into a character family only after defining a clear system metaphor.
Use high saturation and neon contrast when every color is assigned a role: identity, warning, data, emotion or category.
Separate cute IP expression from serious data panels through background mode: white/manual mode for system assets and black/intelligence-board mode for information density.
Use application proof to validate the system: sticker, book, card, packaging, merchandise and physical booth should all repeat the same visual grammar.
For high-density boards, require named clusters, scale jumps and a single dominant overview block.

cross_domain_use.infovis: science communication, data board, periodic-table tile grammar, technical labels
cross_domain_use.vi-brand: IP character family, mascot behavior rules, expression pack, title lettering
cross_domain_use.exhibition-board: graduation project board, competition board, application proof display
cross_domain_use.packaging: card game, book, gift box, peripheral product proof
cross_domain_use.poster: bold science key visual and campaign poster direction

exclusion_rule: Do not copy original mascots, title lettering, product photographs or page composition.
Do not use the original article images as LoRA images without explicit rights.
Do not hallucinate chemical formulas, element names, equations or scientific claims.
Do not turn bold color into uncontrolled neon clutter.
